patch_description: The current hexagonal layout gives sum ≈ 2.36. The main limitation is that the fixed lattice positions are not optimal — circles near the walls are too far from them and circles near the top row (only 3 circles) waste space. A powerful, still "constructor-style" improvement is to add a deterministic local refinement loop: after computing radii, each center is nudged toward the direction that increases its available space (away from close neighbors, toward the walls), then radii are re-grown. We keep the best configuration seen across iterations, guaranteeing we never get worse. This emulates the "relaxation" step that produces the AlphaEvolve-style packings while remaining fully deterministic and feasible (radii are always computed by the safe grow_radii routine).
